Branch Operations Manager, Boyertown, PA

Country: United States of America

It Starts Here:
Santander is a global leader and innovator in the financial services industry and is evolving from a high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization. Our people are at the heart of this journey and together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.  This is more than a strategic shift.  It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

The Difference You Make:
As a Branch Operations Manager, you ensure the branch operates efficiently and securely while delivering exceptional customer experiences and fostering team member growth. You oversee risk controls by ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, minimizing operational risks tied to cash handling and transactions. This role includes enhancing the customer experience by ensuring smooth transaction processing, resolving issues promptly, lobby management and creating a welcoming environment. You serve as a trusted expert, providing clarity on policies, guidance on execution and assistance with escalations.
- Assist customers with various transactions, including deposits, withdrawals and payments.
- Oversee operational risk control measures to safeguard branch assets, including Vault and ATM custodianship.
- Ensure an elevated customer experience, delivering personalized, seamless, and attentive service.
- Effective lobby management to optimize customer flow and engagement.
- Resolve customer issues promptly and effectively.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to elevate their banking experience and foster loyalty.
- Engage customers through digital platforms to enhance customer interactions and educate them on self-service options.
- Conduct cash counts and maintain accurate audit logs.
- Support the teller line, use coaching tools, and provide feedback to ensure efficient and accurate transactions.
- Communicate clearly and effectively with customers in person, over the phone, or through digital channels.
- Utilize data-driven decision-making to improve branch performance and operational efficiency.
- Assist colleagues in achieving their developmental goals and career aspirations.

jobs.description:
Analyst, Global Banking, South Asia Pacific

Country: Singapore

The Analyst will support the South Asia Pacific Global Banking coverage team in managing and developing relationships with a portfolio of leading corporate and institutional clients across the region.

Working closely with senior bankers and Santander's global product and coverage teams, the Analyst will play an important role in identifying and developing business opportunities, preparing strategic and financial analysis, supporting client engagement and coordinating the execution of transactions.

A key objective of the role is to enhance the effectiveness of the coverage team by providing high-quality analytical, origination and execution support, enabling senior bankers to dedicate greater time to strategic dialogue with clients, development of investment banking ideas and origination of new business opportunities for Santander.

Key responsibilities

Client Coverage and Strategic Account Management – Support senior bankers in managing a portfolio of major corporate and institutional relationships across South Asia Pacific, developing a strong understanding of each client's strategy, financial position, capital structure, investment priorities and banking requirements.

Origination and Investment Banking Ideas – Support the development of proactive ideas and business opportunities across Santander's product capabilities, including financing, debt capital markets, advisory, structured finance, transaction banking, markets and other relevant solutions.

Strategic and Financial Analysis – Conduct financial analysis, valuation and capital structure analysis, peer benchmarking, industry research and market intelligence to identify strategic themes, client needs and actionable opportunities for Santander.

Client Materials and Senior Banker Preparation – Prepare high-quality, concise and client-ready materials including pitch books, briefing notes, strategic account plans, relationship reviews and senior management presentations. Provide senior bankers with relevant client, sector and market intelligence ahead of client meetings and strategic discussions.

Client and Sector Intelligence – Proactively monitor developments affecting the team's clients and priority sectors, including corporate strategy, M&A, capital expenditure, financing activity, shareholder developments, industry trends and relevant capital markets activity, and translate these developments into potential client dialogue and business opportunities.

Opportunity and Pipeline Development – Work with senior bankers to identify, prioritise and track opportunities across the client portfolio. Maintain a disciplined view of the team's pipeline, expected revenues, next actions and product penetration, and help ensure timely follow-up on identified opportunities.

Transaction Execution and Coordination – Support the origination and execution of transactions by coordinating with Santander's product teams and relevant internal stakeholders across Global Banking, Global Markets, Risk, Legal, Compliance and Operations, as well as teams across Santander's international network.

Credit and Portfolio Management – Support credit origination and ongoing portfolio management, including preparation of credit applications and annual reviews, financial and exposure analysis, internal approvals and monitoring of client performance and credit developments.

Cross-Border Coordination – Collaborate closely with Santander teams globally to connect South Asia Pacific clients with the Bank's international capabilities and ensure coordinated coverage and seamless execution of cross-border opportunities.

Business Management / Team Effectiveness – Provide analytical and execution leverage to the coverage team by taking ownership of recurring analysis, information preparation, internal coordination and follow-up, allowing senior bankers to focus their time on strategic client engagement, origination and relationship development.

Requirements

- Degree holder in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related discipline, or Engineering.
- Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, Structured Finance, Capital Markets or a related financial services role.
- Strong financial analysis and corporate finance skills, including the ability to analyse financial statements, capital structures, valuation and credit metrics.
- Good understanding of corporate and investment banking products and an interest in developing broader knowledge across financing, capital markets, advisory, transaction banking and markets.
- Excellent research and analytical capabilities, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear conclusions and actionable ideas.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise, high-quality materials for senior bankers and senior client stakeholders.
- Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with strong attention to detail and consistently high standards of execution.
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple tasks, priorities and workstreams simultaneously, exercising sound judgement and taking ownership of deliverables on a timely basis.
- Highly motivated self starter who is proactive, intellectually curious and collaborative, with strong initiatives rather than simply respond to requests.
- Comfortable working across different countries, cultures and time zones in an international banking environment.
- Fluency in English is required.

Chief Compliance Officer

Country: Switzerland

Acting as a second line of defense, the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) is responsible for ensuring adherence to applicable laws, regulations, supervisory expectations, internal policies and the highest standards of ethical conduct. The CCO advises and reports to the Bank’s management body, safeguarding the interests of the Bank, the Group, employees, customers, shareholders and communities.

The Chief Compliance Officer leads the Compliance function by overseeing compliance, conduct and financial crime risks, ensuring that risk-taking activities remain within the Bank’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

The role requires a combination of deep Swiss regulatory expertise, international private banking experience and strong knowledge of cross-border wealth management activities, including exposure to Latin American, European and Middle Eastern markets and clients.

Duties and Responsibilities

- Compliance Strategy : establish the compliance strategy of the Bank and set forth the annual plans for the function, in the following fields considering the group guidelines: i. conduct and customer protection; ii. regulatory compliance; iii. anti-money laundering and prevention of terrorism financing; iv. reputational risk.

- Control and oversight : establish the necessary control and oversight mechanisms to integrate compliance risk information – in accordance with the risk appetite of the Bank and with the principles set forth by the Group - through an information consolidation and reporting process.

- Compliance & Conduct (C&C) corporate principles : manage the process of adopting the C&C corporate principles / policies defined by the Group, and define and manage the implementation of C&C models, policies, guidelines, key processes and control tools as required for the performance of the function within the Bank.

- Management advice : advise the management body on laws, regulations and standards in general that the Bank must comply with and evaluate the impact of changes in the regulatory environment, setting in motion corporate projects to adapt the Bank to the rules and to regulators’ demands and expectations.

- Compliance management : promote the development and implementation of a compliance management and control environment at the Bank that allows for periodic assessment of the adequacy of the compliance procedures in place. Identify potential improvements and set up action plans.

- Main compliance representative : act as the Bank’s main compliance representative and ensure an effective relationship with the Group and other stakeholders, mainly regulators, supervisors and auditors. Provide guidance to the Bank’s top management on their compliance-related responsibilities and advise other functions within the Bank and, when necessary, work with other organizational units or with the Group in forming and stating an opinion at the entity or Group level.

- Regulatory affairs : manage relationships with supervisors and ensure compliance-related requests for information are accommodated appropriately.

- Advise other functions : Advise other functions within the Bank on compliance-related matters. Support the necessary coordination with other functions involved in key processes, particularly to ensure that data quality is high and that the systems needed to perform the compliance function are adequate.

- Strong compliance culture : encourage the emergence of a strong compliance culture at the Bank, providing guidance and facilitating communication and training that ensure the integration of the culture with the day-to-day management throughout the organization.

- Industry trends & best practices : maintain oversight of regulatory developments, industry trends and applicable legal and regulatory requirements, ensuring the adoption of best practices and the continuous enhancement of compliance policies, procedures, controls and monitoring plans..

- Compliance plans : oversee and monitor the implementation of existing compliance plans and propose that they are reviewed when required by changes in the entity’s needs or in applicable laws and regulations.

- Committee Governance and Communication : direct the compliance committee to ensure sufficient oversight, reporting and escalation, participate in other committees if necessary and attend top-level committee when appropriate.

- Proven experience in team leadership

- Experience dealing with clients, business activities and regulatory frameworks related to Swiss and Middle Eastern markets

- Extensive experience managing regulatory interactions and supervisory reviews.

- Demonstrated experience leading compliance transformation, remediation and regulatory change programs.

- Demonstrated experience supporting private banking and wealth management activities involving international clients, family offices and complex structures.

- Strong understanding of cross-border compliance risks and international wealth management structures.

Skills:
- Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, regulators and auditors.

- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performance teams.

- Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities.

- Ability to operate effectively in a multicultural and international environment.

- Arabic is considered an asset.

Country: Spain

Openbank is looking for a Growth Marketing & MarTech Lead to join the new Global Marketing Strategy & Planning team.

Openbank is building a new Global Marketing Strategy & Planning function to take its marketing model to the next level. The team will create reusable capabilities, operating standards and decision tools that help markets move faster, learn from one another and improve the return on existing marketing investment. Local markets will retain execution ownership. The global team will build, test, measure and scale the capabilities that create leverage across Openbank and Santander Consumer Finance.

Mission
Build the Growth Marketing and MarTech capability system that enables Openbank to evolve from predominantly paid, CPA-led acquisition toward diversified, lifecycle-driven growth optimized for long-term customer value. You will connect growth marketing expertise, MarTech product thinking and rigorous experimentation to define global standards, prioritize high-impact use cases and turn market learning into reusable capabilities that can scale across countries.

Key Responsibilities
- Build Growth Marketing capability roadmap . Assess gaps across priority markets in acquisition, CRM/lifecycle, digital channels, conversion, MarTech, personalization and experimentation, and translate them into a phased roadmap based on value and market readiness.
- Shape and scale Openbank's MarTech foundation . Define priority Marketing use cases and business requirements for customer interaction platforms, audience/data capabilities, automation, personalization and AI-driven decisioning; partner with Technology, Product and Data on delivery.
- Establish acquisition and channel best practices. Create reusable standards for full-funnel acquisition, audiences, value-based optimization, paid and owned channels, web/app conversion and CRM/lifecycle activation.
- Build the experimentation operating system . Set a common method for hypotheses, prioritization, test design, learning and scale-or-stop decisions, supported by a transparent cross-market experiment backlog.
- Accelerate lifecycle marketing and personalization . Enable greater use of first-party data, audiences, triggers and customer signals to move from campaign-based communications toward personalized engagement and optimization against customer value.
- Scale AI and emerging growth use cases . Build pragmatic use cases across AI decisioning, personalization, automation, LLM/GEO discoverability, creator/influencer acquisition and content-driven growth, partnering with Brand on content and creative ownership.
- Turn pilots into reusable global assets . Launch lighthouse use cases with priority markets and convert proven interventions into playbooks, templates, requirements and implementation guides that other markets can adopt quickly.
- Bridge Marketing, Technology and Data . Translate commercial opportunities into clear technology/data requirements, help prioritize the Marketing backlog and surface integration, tracking, privacy or infrastructure gaps.
- Build capability, not dependency . Create global/local decision rights, standards, training and communities of practice that strengthen local teams while avoiding duplicated specialist structures.
- Work hands-on. Personally produce diagnostics, playbooks, experiment charters, use-case maps, channel reviews, requirements and executive recommendations; this is not a coordination-only role.

- Faster learning velocity . A common experimentation system turns local tests into a cross-market learning portfolio with explicit scale, adapt or stop decisions.
